seo.title: Our work — freedom stories, Constitution and civic duty
seo.description: The programmes Desh Bhakt runs: freedom stories, Constitution awareness, civic service and national symbols.

blocks.heading: Our work
blocks.sub: Four simple programmes that anyone can take part in.

cards.title: Stories of freedom
cards.text: We collect and retell the stories of freedom fighters, including those history books rarely mention, so that young people know whose shoulders they stand on.

cards.title: Know your Constitution
cards.text: Short, jargon-free explainers on the Preamble, Fundamental Rights and Fundamental Duties, suitable for schools and community groups.

cards.title: Civic service
cards.text: Neighbourhood clean-ups, voter awareness, tree planting and respect for public property: patriotism you can practise on a Sunday morning.

cards.title: National symbols
cards.text: The meaning behind the Tiranga, the National Anthem and the State Emblem, and the correct way to display and honour them.

blocks.text: Programme dates and locations are announced on our Articles page and by email.
